title: What Whole-Body Regeneration Is
definition: Whole-Body Regeneration: regrowing damaged tissues across the entire body.
description:
Whole-Body Regeneration — Signature Edition: regrowing damaged tissues across the entire body. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature regeneration hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: stem banks rethought, regeneration logistics rebuilt, scaffold printing reimagined for the century ahead. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the growth factors ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: 2030 — First regeneration logistics therapies clear regulators for spec
title: 2030 — First regeneration logistics therapies clear regulators for spec
definition: 2030 milestone on the Whole-Body Regeneration roadmap.
description:
First regeneration logistics therapies clear regulators for specific scaffold printing conditions; regeneration hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the stem banks results have to replicate outside the lab, regeneration logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and scaffold printing operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed stem banks demonstrations, regeneration logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting scaffold printing uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Whole-Body Regeneration
definition: Estimates Whole-Body Regeneration readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Whole-Body Regeneration components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a regeneration hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Whole-Body Regeneration Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Whole-Body Regeneration operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Whole-Body Regeneration installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 9991 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where stem banks monitoring, regeneration logistics redundancy, or scaffold printing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Whole-Body Regeneration Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Whole-Body Regeneration: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Whole-Body Regeneration — regrowing damaged tissues across the entire body.

Phase 1 — Prove (stem banks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (regeneration logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scaffold printing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (growth factors): regeneration hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and trauma care-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
